summary: Python 2.0 introduced list comprehensions (borrowed from SETL and Haskell), a cycle-detecting garbage collector, reference counting, and Unicode support. It marked a shift to a more transparent, community-backed development process. Python 2.0 was the only release from BeOpen.com; after its release, Van Rossum and PythonLabs joined Digital Creations (Zope).
notes: Unsupported since 2001-06-22. Last micro 2.0.1. Python 2.0 established patterns that would define Python for two decades.
